    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:

        if arr.shape[0] == 0:

        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if not (arr <= 0).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (log probabilities must be <= 0)")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != (n_candidates, horizon):
        raise ValueError(f"Shape mismatch: logp_call_only {logp_call_only.shape} != {logp_with_result.shape}")
    if logp_no_call.shape != (n_candidates, horizon):
        raise ValueError(f"Shape mismatch: logp_no_call {logp_no_call.shape} != {logp_with_result.shape}")

    # Validate threshold
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a Boolean value")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError(f"tau_filter must be finite, got {tau_filter}")
    if tau_filter < 0:

    # Step T01: Normalize decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)  # 0, 1, 2, ...
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    if weight_sum == 0.0:
        # Edge case: all raw weights zero (should not happen for finite horizon)
        normalized_weights = np.ones_like(raw_weights) / horizon
    else:
        normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Step T02: Compute weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log probability)
